paper_id: Xu et al. - 2015 - Enhancing wifi-based localization with visual clues
title: Enhancing WiFi-based Localization with Visual Clues
motivation: WiFi fingerprinting suffers from ambiguity due to multipath fading, and existing motion/peer-assisted solutions are impractical
problem_framing: Two distinct locations may possess similar RSS fingerprints, causing large localization errors
key_insight: Extract geometric constraints from crowdsourced photos via SfM and map them onto fingerprint space to resolve ambiguity
method_signature: Joint optimization of WiFi fingerprints and SfM-derived geometric polygon constraints
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Large errors exist for low quality WiFi samples, extreme distances, similar POI appearance, and POI obstruction
evidence_for_taste: limit the mean localization error to less than 1m
acceptable as long as the majority of POI is clearly taken
Argus may degenerate to multi-sample WiFi localization
thinking_moves: Identify WiFi-only limitation through observation: large errors from ambiguous fingerprints
Repurpose SfM output (relative positions) as constraints rather than absolute coordinates
Frame localization as combinatorial optimization with geometric constraints
Replace human effort with crowdsourced image collection
Address practical concerns (device diversity, latency, energy) as first-class requirements
